lesson-intro.text: A bowl of ramen has a lot going on, so we'll take it slowly: bowl, toppings, noodles, chopsticks. Watch it fill up, then start your own bowl.

soup-front.text: Begin with the soup, a wide flat oval. Draw its front edge in two curves, left then right.

rim-back.text: Draw the back of the oval, and the rim just above it. Both stop where things stand in front.

body.text: Now the bowl itself. From each end of the rim, curve down and under. Add a small foot.

seaweed.text: A sheet of seaweed stands in the left gap. Draw a tilted box with soft corners.

chopsticks.text: Two chopsticks rest in the right gap. Each is a long thin box leaning out.

egg.text: Float half an egg at the front left. Draw an oval, and a circle inside for the yolk.

noodles.text: Noodles next. Draw three wavy lines across the soup, each with three waves.

onions.text: Three small circles on the right are slices of green onion.

greens.text: Color the seaweed dark green and the onions light green.

egg-sticks.text: The egg is cream with an orange yolk. Color the chopsticks brown.

lesson-outro.text: Every noodle and topping in that bowl came from you. It looks worth slurping.
